meta.name: crewai
meta.description: Expert in CrewAI - the leading role-based multi-agent framework used by 60% of Fortune 500 companies. Covers agent design with roles and goals, task definition, crew orchestration, process types (sequential, hierarchical, parallel), memory systems, and flows for complex workflows. Essential for building collaborative AI agent teams. Use when: crewai, multi-agent team, agent roles, crew of agents, role-based agents.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 编排多智能体团队完成复杂工作流
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要用多个AI角色协同完成复杂任务
copy.tagline_en: Orchestrate multi-agent teams for complex workflows
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to coordinate multiple AI agents with different roles to accomplish complex tasks

howto.what: 装上后，当你说到“CrewAI”或“多智能体团队”时，Claude 会变成一个 CrewAI 架构师，帮你设计智能体角色、任务、流程（顺序/层级）和记忆系统，并生成 Python 代码。
howto.when: 当你提到“CrewAI”、“多智能体团队”、“智能体角色”等关键词，或要求设计基于角色的协作AI团队时触发。

say.text: 帮我用CrewAI创建一个内容创作团队，包含研究员和写手。
用层级流程设计一个分析项目，由管理智能体协调。
为我的研究任务开启计划功能。

howto.what_en: When activated, Claude becomes a CrewAI architect that designs agent roles, tasks, processes (sequential/hierarchical), memory, and generates Python code for multi-agent teams.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention 'CrewAI', 'multi-agent team', 'agent roles', or ask to design role-based AI agent teams.

say_en.text: Create a content crew with a researcher and a writer using CrewAI.
say_en.note: Claude generates YAML config and crew.py.

say_en.text: Design a hierarchical crew for data analysis with a manager.
Enable planning for my research crew.
